title: Cañón del Micay campesino action after Nov. 27 highway blockade
description: El País Cali reports the same Cañón del Micay communities moved from El Cofre/Cajibío (where they had arrived Nov. 26) into Popayán; more than 500 campesinos reached Popayán and actually mobilized through Parque Caldas on Dec. 2 to seek direct dialogue with President Petro. They returned toward their territories to plan a future Bogotá action. El Espectador search snippet says intermittent roadblocks at El Cofre were still occurring over the weekend. A later Bogotá action and the campaign end are not confirmed; no separate Dec event is created.
